Name: Heartbeats
Description: Every heartbeat as an event, for heartbeat-evoked potentials: the R-peaks of an ECG (a channel, a stream of the recording's XDF file, or another device's recording lined up on shared triggers) found exactly as spectHR finds them (the ECG turned upright if inverted, a 0.5 Hz high-pass, peaks above the median plus 1.5 SD at least 300 ms apart, placed to a fraction of a sample), each an event with its interval to the next beat and its heart rate. A check on the heart's field in the EEG confirms the beats are on time. The data are not changed. Choose the heartbeats per condition with DefineBins, then Average. Continuous data only.
